cases.setup: Provide a public Python analyzer checkout with the reported alias-string false positive, a working function-annotation control, and inspectable owner code.
checks: The record identifies hashed anchors and real bindings for annotated-assignment analysis, annotation analysis, typing-marker recognition, and regression tests.
The baseline record contains actual diagnostics for the alias-string reproduction and function-annotation control.
The compatible output is emitted only if the recognizer and annotation handler are confirmed compatible.
Source files are not modified by the probe.

cases.setup: Supply a PASS probe record and bound current owners matching the supported semantic architecture.
checks: The diff routes values through annotation analysis only when the annotation is recognized as TypeAlias.
Target handling, declared-annotation handling, ordinary value traversal, and the missing-value guard remain present.
Regression assertions cover module and class direct/string aliases and both valueless-declaration cases.
The output is marked awaiting public validation rather than verified.
Validation freshness is invalidated without invalidating required preservation assurances.

cases.setup: Supply an edited candidate, current public oracle bindings, and a supported Python environment with the repository test runner available.
checks: Executed public commands and their observed results are recorded.
Imported types used in direct/string aliases in module/class scopes are not reported unused.
A valueless declaration does not manufacture a use of an unrelated imported type.
An ordinary assignment string containing an imported name does not suppress the corresponding unused-import diagnostic.
The function-annotation control and adjacent annotation regression checks pass.
A failed or unexecuted required check prevents emission of the required-public-checks-passed output.
The validation report states the scope actually executed and does not claim whole-project or cross-project success without corresponding results.
